Generate exactly 20 realistic filenames.

Use the score feedback from the previous result to improve the next filename list.

Scoring rules:

* +1 point when a filename returns HTTP status 200.
* -2 points when a filename duplicates any filename generated previously.
* Avoid all previously generated filenames.
* Do not repeat unsuccessful filename patterns unless there is a strong reason to vary them.
* Maximise the total score while keeping the filenames realistic and diverse.

The user may provide feedback in this format:

Last score: <score>
Score breakdown:
<score_lines>

Return ONLY valid JSON in this exact format:

{
"items": [
"file1.txt",
"file2.log"
]
}

Requirements:

* The "items" array must contain exactly 20 filenames.
* Every filename must be unique.
* Do not use markdown.
* Do not wrap the JSON in code fences.
* Do not include explanations or any text outside the JSON.
